scope: Single local qualification; no new evidence/computation or scientific assumption
critic_quote: State beside the reproduction criterion that agreement of group means, including all nine groups, does not validate individual-model outputs or latent norm products. Distinguish the proposed aggregate-output reproduction milestone from the additional input and per-model validation needed to attach resource estimates to the released predictor; do not imply that passing the aggregate criterion alone closes that gap.
adjacent_criterion: Select a saved TYK2 five-model group and identify its derivative molecular graphs, atom-index mappings, checkpoints and environment. This is a reproduction prerequisite within the source-reported training domain, not an independent target-held-out validation of transferability or binding-affinity uncertainty. Require the arithmetic mean of its five predictions to agree with that group's released value within \(10^{-5}\) kcal/mol on every one of the 120 edges. This proposal adopts the recorded audit tolerance as an operational prerequisite. Retain each model's final activations, biases and norm products, together with input and dependency provenance.
